description: A guard placed only in engine message hooks misses requests the engine makes for itself.

input.scenario: The host declares a masking guard on model requests and points the engine at a mock model provider that logs every request body. A tool returns the canary string CANARY-7f3a-SECRET, which the guard masks. The guard is installed only as the engine's context/before-request hook; the engine compacts its context.

expect.behaviour: This placement does not meet R019: the compaction request reaches the mock provider with CANARY-7f3a-SECRET. A conforming host places the guard on the model transport, and the canary never arrives.
